en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Nineteenth Chapter
Discourse on the Faculties:
Is there no mundane faculty of faith? Yes.
Is it not the case that there is no mundane faith?
One should certainly not say so...
[and so on] ...there is no mundane faculty of energy... [and so on].
Is it the faculty of mindfulness …pe… the faculty of concentration …pe… the faculty of wisdom?
“Yes,” you say.
“Is there no worldly wisdom (paññā)?
You should not say so… [and so on].
Is there mundane faith?
Yes. Is there a mundane faculty of faith? Yes.
It should not be said thus … [and so on] … there is mundane energy … mindfulness … [and so on].
Is it concentration … pe … wisdom? Yes.
Is there a mundane faculty of wisdom?
One should not say so… [as before] … Is there a mundane mind,
and is there a mundane faculty of mind?
“Yes,” [you say].
“Is there mundane faith? Is there a mundane faculty of faith?
You should not speak thus … [and so on] …
Is there worldly mind, and is there the worldly faculty of mind?
Yes. Is there worldly wisdom, and is there the worldly faculty of wisdom?
It should not be said thus ... [as before] ...
There is worldly joy; there is the worldly faculty of joy ...
pe ... there is worldly life; there is the worldly faculty of life?
“Yes,” you say.
“Is there mundane faith? Is there the mundane faculty of faith?
You should not say so … [and so on] …
Is there mundane life, and is there the mundane life-faculty?
Yes. Is there mundane wisdom, and is there the mundane wisdom-faculty?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is there worldly faith, but no worldly faculty of faith? Yes.
Is there worldly mind, but no worldly mind-faculty?
One should not say so … [and so on] … Is there worldly wisdom, but no worldly wisdom-faculty? One should not say so.
“Yes,” you say.
“Is there a worldly mind, but no worldly mind-faculty?
You should not speak thus … [and so on].
Is there mundane faith, but no mundane faculty of faith?
Yes. Is there mundane mental joy, but no mundane faculty of mental joy? Yes. …
Is there worldly life, but no worldly life-faculty?
One should not say so …pe… Is there worldly wisdom, but no worldly wisdom-faculty?
“Yes.
“Then there is worldly mind, but no worldly mind-faculty … [and so on] … there is worldly life, but no worldly life-faculty?”
It should not be said so … [as before] … Is there supramundane faith? Is there a supramundane faculty of faith? Yes.
Is there mundane faith? Is there the mundane faculty of faith?
One should not say so …pe… Is there supramundane energy? …pe…
Is there supramundane wisdom? Is there a supramundane faculty of wisdom?
Yes. Is there mundane wisdom? Is there a mundane faculty of wisdom? Yes.
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is there worldly faith, but no worldly faculty of faith? Yes.
Is there supramundane faith, but no supramundane faculty of faith?
One should not say so …pe… Is there mundane energy …pe…?
Is there mundane wisdom, but no mundane faculty of wisdom?
Yes. Is there supramundane wisdom, but no supramundane faculty of wisdom? Yes.
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it not the case that there are no mundane five faculties?
Yes, it is.
Has it not been said by the Blessed One: "Bhikkhus,
while surveying the world with the eye of a Buddha, I saw beings with little dust on their eyes and with much dust on their eyes,
with keen faculties and with dull faculties, of good disposition and easy to instruct, some of whom dwelt seeing fear in the blame of the world beyond"?
Is that indeed the Sutta? Yes.
Therefore, it follows that there are mundane five faculties.
The Discussion on the Faculties is finished.
This is the nineteenth chapter.
Its summary verse is as follows:
One abandons past defilements, one abandons future defilements, and one abandons present defilements.
Emptiness is included within the aggregate of mental formations;
the fruit of recluseship is unconditioned.
The unconditioned is the suchness of all phenomena; the unconditioned is the element of Nibbāna, which is wholesome.
There is absolute certainty for the worldling;
there are no mundane five faculties.
